name: list-binding-pattern-test-b87d28a686/list-binding-pattern-rest-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports [const-pattern](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#const-pattern) and [wildcard-match-pattern](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wildcard-match-pattern)
### Other invocation restrictions: Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions: array:push; value:toString and value:toBalString
reason: The assertions require match clauses with variable list binding patterns and rest captures, including nested lists, tuple/closed-array element extraction, minimum-length matching, and JSON rest-array mutation. These patterns fall outside the explicitly supported constant and wildcard match patterns.
unsupported_constructs: Variable list binding patterns in match clauses, including ...rest captures and nested list patterns
test_design_notes: array:push and value:toString are explicitly supported; io:println is disabled instrumentation and does not determine classification.
